instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: After pembrolizumab cycle 4, a client develops new dry cough, bilateral basilar crackles, progressive SpO2 decline from 96% baseline to 91% on room air, PaO2 68 mmHg, elevated CRP, and CT showing new bilateral lower-lobe ground-glass opacities without pleural effusion, pulmonary embolism, or lymphangitic carcinomatosis. The oncologist orders pembrolizumab held, admission, oxygen to maintain SpO2 >=94%, methylprednisolone per facility irAE pneumonitis protocol, every-2-hour pulse oximetry, and pulmonology consult. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
